# `aitbc operations agent register`

Register an agent with a status.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations agent register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--agent-id` | text | — | yes | Agent ID |
| `--status` | choice | `active` | no | Agent status |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations agent register --agent-id <agent_id>
```
